pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: High-level introduction to the Aria Automation (aka vRA) IaaS TypeScript SDK and MCP Server monorepo — what it does, how the two packages relate, and where to start. Links to child pages for details.

pages.title: Getting Started
pages.purpose: Step-by-step guide for installing the SDK, configuring credentials, running the first API call, and setting up the MCP server with Claude Desktop. Covers environment variables, build steps, and the examples/ directory.

pages.title: Repository Structure
pages.purpose: Explains the monorepo layout: root SDK package vs. packages/mcp-server sub-package, the src/ resource tree, tests/, scripts/, and how the two packages depend on each other.

pages.title: vRA IaaS SDK — Core Architecture
pages.purpose: Overview of the generated TypeScript SDK: the VraIaas client class, request pipeline, error handling, and internal utilities. Links to child pages for each major subsystem.

pages.title: vRA IaaS Client & Request Pipeline
pages.purpose: Deep dive into src/client.ts — ClientOptions, authentication (bearerToken), baseURL resolution, retry logic with exponential backoff, timeout handling, fetch abstraction, and the APIPromise class (src/core/api-promise.ts).

pages.title: Error Handling
pages.purpose: Documents the error class hierarchy in src/core/error.ts: VraIaasError → APIError → BadRequestError, AuthenticationError, PermissionDeniedError, NotFoundError, RateLimitError, InternalServerError, APIConnectionError, and APIConnectionTimeoutError. Explains how errors are generated and caught.

pages.title: Internal Utilities & Helpers
pages.purpose: Covers the src/internal/ layer: request-options, headers, parse, detect-platform, shims, uploads, and the utils/ sub-directory (env, log, path, sleep, uuid, values, bytes, base64). Explains how these support the client without being part of the public API.

pages.title: IaaS API Resources
pages.purpose: Overview of the 266-endpoint resource tree under src/resources/iaas/api/. Introduces the resource categories and links to child pages for each domain area.

pages.title: Cloud Accounts
pages.purpose: Documents the cloud account resources: CloudAccountsAws, CloudAccountsAzure, CloudAccountsGcp, CloudAccountsVsphere, CloudAccountsNsxT, CloudAccountsNsxV, CloudAccountsVcf, CloudAccountsVmc, CloudAccountsAvilb. Covers CRUD operations and provider-specific enumeration methods (region, image).

pages.title: Compute & Machines
pages.purpose: Documents the Machines resource (src/resources/iaas/api/machines/) including sub-resources: Disks, NetworkInterfaces, Operations, Snapshots. Also covers Zones, Regions, FabricComputes, ComputeGateways, ComputeNats, and FlavorProfiles.

pages.title: Networking
pages.purpose: Documents network-related resources: Networks, NetworkProfiles, NetworkDomains, NetworkIPRanges, ExternalIPBlocks, ExternalNetworkIPRanges, FabricNetworks, FabricNetworksVsphere, SecurityGroups, LoadBalancers, and Integrations (IPAM).

pages.title: Storage
pages.purpose: Documents storage resources: StorageProfiles (generic), StorageProfilesAws, StorageProfilesAzure, StorageProfilesGcp, StorageProfilesVsphere, BlockDevices, FabricVsphereDatastores, FabricVsphereStoragePolicies, FabricAzureStorageAccounts. Explains storage profile hierarchy and cloud-specific variants.

pages.title: Projects, Deployments & Governance
pages.purpose: Documents Projects (with sub-resources Zones), Deployments, Tags, ImageProfiles, Naming, DataCollectors, ConfigurationProperties, RequestTracker, and the top-level API utility methods (login, about, event logs, request graph).

pages.title: MCP Server
pages.purpose: Overview of the packages/mcp-server sub-package: what it is, how it wraps the vRA IaaS SDK for AI assistant consumption, and links to child pages covering each component.

pages.title: Server Initialization & Transports
pages.purpose: Covers packages/mcp-server/src/index.ts (main entrypoint, startup sequence), server.ts (initMcpServer, newMcpServer, tool registry, logging bridge), stdio.ts (launchStdioServer), and http.ts (launchStreamableHTTPServer with Express). Explains transport selection logic.

pages.title: Authentication & Configuration
pages.purpose: Documents auth.ts (ensureBearerToken — auto-login via VRA_FQDN/VRA_USERNAME/VRA_PASSWORD, cspAuthToken capture), options.ts (CLIOptions, McpOptions, parseCLIOptions via yargs), and headers.ts (parseAuthHeaders for HTTP transport). Covers NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED behavior.

pages.title: MCP Tools — Execute & Docs Search
pages.purpose: Deep dive into the two MCP tools: code-tool.ts (the 'execute' meta-tool — Function constructor sandbox, console capture, run(client) pattern, design rationale) and docs-search-tool.ts (search_docs tool, Stainless docs search API). Covers types.ts (McpTool, ToolCallResult, HandlerFunction, asTextContentResult, asErrorResult).

pages.title: Docker & Deployment
pages.purpose: Covers the Dockerfile (multi-stage build, non-root user, stdio default), .dockerignore, manifest.json (DXT manifest for MCP host registration, user_config schema), and how to run the server as a container or registered MCP extension.

pages.title: Build System & Tooling
pages.purpose: Overview of the build pipeline, scripts, and development tooling. Links to child pages for the SDK build and CI/CD.

pages.title: SDK Build Pipeline
pages.purpose: Explains scripts/build (tsc-multi dual CJS/ESM compilation, postprocess-files, fix-index-exports, make-dist-package-json), scripts/utils/ helpers (check-version, git-swap, attw-report, check-is-in-git-install), the prepare lifecycle hook, and how dist/ is structured for publishing.

pages.title: Testing
pages.purpose: Documents the Jest-based test suite in tests/api-resources/iaas/api/ — one test file per resource, Prism mock server usage (TEST_API_BASE_URL), asResponse/withResponse patterns, and how to run tests locally with scripts/test and scripts/mock.

pages.title: CI/CD & Release Automation
pages.purpose: Covers .github/workflows/ci.yml (lint, build, test jobs), publish-npm.yml (NPM publishing), release-doctor.yml (pre-release checks), bin/check-release-environment, release-please-config.json, .release-please-manifest.json, and the Conventional Commits → SemVer version bump lifecycle.

pages.title: Glossary
pages.purpose: Definitions of all codebase-specific terms, abbreviations, and domain concepts an onboarding engineer needs to know, with code pointers.
